seo.titulo: La Urbana Burger | Burgers in Lugo, Vigo & Santiago
seo.descripcion: Signature burgers made with km 0 Galician produce in Lugo, Vigo and Santiago de Compostela. Rubia Galega beef and artisan bread. Book a table or order delivery.

origen.label: Our origin:
origen.title: Rubia Gallega
origen.body: Hand-picked local beef is the secret behind artisan burgers that are out of this world. Everything we use goes straight from farm to table.

esencia.label: Our essence
esencia.title: #laurbanastyle
esencia.body: We're a modern restaurant, and to us modern means bringing people together. Handmade food and local produce to enjoy in an urban setting. Everyone's welcome in our neighbourhood.

secretos.title: Restaurants
secretos.body: At La Urbana Vigo and Lugo – Augas Férreas, kids get their very own secret hideout: an ordering kiosk, a supervised play area, a screen and a table to eat at without the grown-ups (who, let's face it, are very boring)

seo.descripcion: Our menu: Made in Galicia burgers, signature burgers, sandwiches, salads, starters and desserts. Km 0 Galician produce in every dish at La Urbana.
La Urbana Burger Bar allergen chart: burgers, starters, salads, desserts and kids' menu. Check the allergens in every dish before you order.

alergenos.aviso: For your safety, please let our team know about any intolerance.

seo.descripcion: Rubia Galega beef, artisan bread from Lugo, free-range eggs, organic honey and Galician PDO cheeses: the local produce behind every La Urbana burger.

nosotros.intro: Galicia is quality in its purest form, and as the saying goes… for eating, it's Lugo! That's exactly what our burgers are: Galician beef, artisan bread and local ingredients we know by name. We back produce from right here and, whenever we can, organic. And boy, can you tell!

seo.descripcion: At La Urbana Vigo and Lugo – Augas Férreas, kids have their own secret hideout: an ordering kiosk, a play area, a screen and a table all to themselves.

kids.intro: We love mums and dads. That's why we've built your little ones a Secret Restaurant inside our restaurants. Happy kids, even happier grown-ups. ;)
kids.subtitulo: A secret that's not so secret any more.
kids.texto: Only in Lugo (Augas Férreas) and Vigo, hidden inside La Urbana, there's a secret restaurant. One where the kids are in charge. Their own ordering kiosk, a play area, a screen and a kids-only table. Grown-ups sit at theirs.
